title: Toolkit binding not automatically available after access request approval
description: When using `jentic access request --wait` to request toolkit access, the approval completes successfully but the new toolkit binding is not immediately usable. The agent must manually run `jentic access refresh` to pick up the new binding, which is a poor user experience.
reproduction_steps: Attempt to use the toolkit binding immediately
Observe that binding is not available until `jentic access refresh` is run
expected_behavior: After `--wait` flag completes and approval is granted, the toolkit binding should be immediately available for use, either by automatically refreshing the token or by the command itself returning an updated token.
actual_behavior: The approval completes but the agent must manually discover and run `jentic access refresh` to actually use the new toolkit binding.
evidence: Agent had to manually run `jentic access refresh` to pick up new toolkit binding after approval; not automatic
Agent used `jentic access request jentic-test/test-api --wait` which was approved in seconds
Let me refresh my token to get the new toolkit binding and verify it.
